status: Concept B / Sample 2 approved by the user on 2026-10-30 for responsive homepage development.
objective: Retain the existing education platform and redesign its homepage through individually developed agriculture-education and agritech-learning sections.
user_constraints: Education platform: degree programmes, universities, course-offering comparison and admission counselling.
Agriculture theme through green/sage surfaces, curriculum, student learning, relevant illustrations and academic context.
Avoid vegetable/produce marketplace imagery, a replacement dashboard, and a generic recolouring of DRCC.
Elaborate the sections screen by screen with the same level of care as DRCC.
Retain and improve the B.Sc. Agriculture versus B.Tech. Agricultural Engineering comparison.
deliverable: Two complete homepage concepts, each split into upper sections 1–6 and lower sections 7–12.

concepts.name: Academic Fieldbook
concepts.composition: Science and engineering course-path panels; university study cards; bespoke scientific line illustrations; an academic comparison table; a practical-learning map and editorial guide feature.

concepts.name: AgriTech Campus
concepts.composition: A tabbed curriculum explorer; university directory with campus-selection guidance; an engineering-learning feature; comparison dossiers; degree-to-career pathways and an academic guide shelf.

sections.name: Education hero and programme finder
sections.purpose: Identify the platform as agriculture higher education, let the student begin a programme or university search.

sections.name: Three guidance services
sections.purpose: Provide clear programme, comparison and counselling entry points on one integrated surface.

sections.name: Programme explorer
sections.purpose: Show degree-level choices with curriculum topics and comparison controls, using distinct academic UI per concept.

sections.name: University discovery
sections.purpose: Connect degree interest to institutions, programme details, campus learning and official admissions.

sections.name: Agriculture and technology learning feature
sections.purpose: Explain precision agriculture, soil/water systems and food engineering through student learning and technical illustrations.

sections.name: Agriculture versus Agricultural Engineering
sections.purpose: Compare study focus, core subjects, practical learning, broad career areas and institution-specific eligibility links.

sections.name: Admission journey
sections.purpose: Guide explore, compare and counselling actions with a small academic preparation checklist.

sections.name: Practical learning and career exploration
sections.purpose: Connect degrees to laboratory, field, engineering-studio and broad career-exploration themes.

sections.name: Student guides
sections.purpose: Provide thoughtful academic resources for course choice, university comparison and admission preparation.

sections.name: News and learning updates
sections.purpose: Use curated CMS editorial content rather than invented admissions notices.

sections.name: Frequently asked questions
sections.purpose: Answer course, institution, eligibility and guidance questions in a fully designed section.

sections.name: Counselling callback
sections.purpose: Retain the existing lead flow with an accessible form and a distinct academic-guidance visual.

factual_basis.comparison: Programme-specific academic examples, not a promise that every university has the same curriculum or eligibility.
factual_basis.agriculture: Plant, soil and crop-science study themes; laboratory and field learning.
factual_basis.agricultural_engineering: Engineering applications; machinery, soil/water systems, processing and practical technical work.
factual_basis.agritech: A study and practical-learning theme, not machinery sales, a farm dashboard or a claim that all listed degrees teach drones.
factual_basis.institution_names: Directory examples only; no implied partnership, accreditation claim, ranking or approved branding.
factual_basis.imagery: Generated illustrative university/student scenes and original academic line artwork; not authenticated named-campus photography.

research.name: ICAR
research.lesson: Separate agriculture disciplines, education, research, knowledge and practical outcomes.

research.name: TNAU undergraduate programmes
research.lesson: Agriculture, horticulture, forestry, agricultural engineering, food technology and agribusiness as distinct discovery paths.

research.name: TNAU postgraduate programmes
research.lesson: Give undergraduate, postgraduate and diploma discovery separate entry points; examples include agronomy and agribusiness.

research.name: ICAR-IARI
research.lesson: Use field learning, laboratories, research and campus opportunities to explain agricultural education.

research.name: Punjab Agricultural University undergraduate programmes
research.lesson: Keep degree, college, facilities and practical education navigation clear.

research.name: Wageningen University & Research
research.lesson: Connect study pathways to food, climate, biodiversity and living-environment themes.

research.name: UC Davis CAES
research.lesson: Make majors, advising and career discovery visible.

research.name: ICAR CUET undergraduate bulletin
research.lesson: Keep official admission resources distinct from platform guidance.

research.name: ICAR postgraduate entrance reforms
research.lesson: Keep examination names, eligibility and dates editable and linked to official notices; do not infer future rules.

research.name: WUR programme finder
research.lesson: A functional programme finder exposes interest filters, degree navigation and an explicit results area.

research.name: TNAU Agricultural Engineering programme
research.used_for: Programme focus, soil/water, farm machinery, food processing and practical engineering distinctions.

research.name: TNAU hands-on drone workshop for B.Tech students
research.used_for: An authentic example of agritech as academic hands-on learning.

research.name: ICAR-IARI precision agriculture training
research.used_for: Precision, drone, robotics and sensor learning as educational themes.

implementation_plan.reuse: Existing programme, institution, offering-comparison, guide, FAQ and callback data flows.
implementation_plan.homepage: Create a coherent Agrico component and token system; keep shared data relationships and routes.
implementation_plan.new_section_ui: Use curated CMS content for agritech learning, course pathways and programme-specific comparison facts.
implementation_plan.responsive: Design each section with mobile stacking, readable comparison access, compact course search and clear primary actions.
implementation_plan.scope_now: Implement the approved Concept B homepage in the Agrico workspace, preserving existing platform routes and enquiry flows.

generation.kind: Upper/lower UI mockups with matched continuation screens
